text:
Sam: pushed a PoC for adaptive-priority routing to staging — wires per-route weights + capability filters. would love quick UX + safety checks before we flip it on.
Maria: nice. what's the fallback behavior if the weighted model is incompatible with the request (e.g., tenant header + model_pin + version_range)?
Sam: current prototype: explicit pin -> alias resolution -> compatibility filter -> default alias. if nothing compatible, we return 503 with error code 'no-compatible-model'. we briefly discussed auto-fallback to quantized variant but worried about quality regressions.
Raj: prefer deterministic tie-breaker when weights equal so we don't have flapping on pins. also need clear telemetry: routed_model, decision_reason, and decision_path for every request.
Liz: console UX request: show rollout slider with live sampled traffic % and a small "degrade preview" indicating what fraction would land on fallback. also add a preview mode that only routes based on request-id sampling so we can validate without impacting users.
Kevin: can we express capability constraints in the routing DSL? something like:
```yaml
route: tenant=example
select:
  weighted_alias:
    - alias: product-gen-v2
      weight: 60
      if: supports_streaming == true
    - alias: product-gen-v1
      weight: 40
require:
  - supports_streaming
  - kv_cache
allow_tenant_pin: true
```
this is rough but shows intent: weights + predicates + global requires.
Maria: that DSL looks close to what we need. two asks: (1) support version ranges (e.g. alias:v1 <= version < v3) and (2) an explicit conflict resolution policy (prefer newer patch vs prefer pinned).
Raj: quotas interaction: if route quota is exhausted we should fallback to cheaper/quantized model instead of immediate reject where possible. policy chain: throttle -> fallback -> reject. ops needs metrics for each step.
Liz: UX: when a policy contains capability predicates, show simulated match coverage against last 24h traffic (eg: "supports_streaming matches 3.2% of requests"). helps avoid silent rules that never match.
Kevin: edge-case: tenants can send X-Model-Pin header. we should have clear precedence: internal_override -> route_policy_pin -> tenant_pin -> default_alias. also require ACL to allow tenant_pin on a route (`allow_tenant_pin`).
Sam: agreed. current impl has allow_tenant_pin flag but we need console ACLs and an audit trail for header-based pins. also need to whitelist which tenants can self-pin.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: CI build 2026-03-19T12:11:07Z - adaptive-priority-routing PoC deployed to staging (sha: f2a9c3e).
Maria: i will draft telemetry schema changes. fields to add: `selected_model`, `fallback_reason`, `policy_version`, `route_id`, `selection_trace` (small enum). keep payload tiny for high-qps.
Sam: thanks — can you also add a sample of selection_trace values? thinking: `explicit_pin`, `alias_resolved`, `compatibility_filter`, `quota_fallback`, `no_compatible`.
Raj: add histogram for decision_latency as well (ms). we also want a counter for "fallbacks_by_reason" to drive optimize suggestions.
Liz: small follow-up: console should surface recently changed policies + a "simulate" button that runs a policy against a pasted request sample and returns which model would be chosen and why.
Kevin: one more nit: we need SDK-level helpers to attach model decision metadata to traces (opentelemetry attr keys). suggest keys: `redwood.model.selected`, `redwood.model.reason`, `redwood.model.policy_id`.
Sam: action items: (1) Maria to PR telemetry schema + small retention note, (2) Kevin to propose DSL tweaks for version ranges & precedence, (3) Liz to mock console UX for rollout slider + simulate, (4) Raj to add metrics list and suggested dashboards. i'll follow up with PoC route config in the thread.
Maria: sounds good. i'll start telemetry PR tomorrow.
Sam: posting PoC route config below for folks to eyeball:
```yaml
- id: route/tenant-example/*
  match: headers.X-Tenant == "example"
  allow_tenant_pin: true
  selection_policy:
    type: weighted_alias
    variants:
      - alias: product-gen-v2
        weight: 60
        requires: [supports_streaming]
      - alias: product-gen-v1
        weight: 40
  fallback_chain: [quantized-v2, alias:product-gen-v1, default-alias]
  quota_policy:
    limit_per_minute: 20000
    on_exhaust: fallback_to_cheaper
```
Raj: looks useful. minor: `on_exhaust: fallback_to_cheaper` should include a max-degradation cap so we don't silently route to tiny models for high-value tenants.
Liz: thumbs up. i'll sketch the UI flows after lunch.
Kevin: will PR DSL changes next week.
Sam: thanks all :thumbsup:
Liz: :eyes:
Maria: ack
